title: Armature Activity Index Schema
description: Schema for activity log summaries (armature-activity-indexer skill output, finding aid for reviewer)

log_digest.description: SHA-256 digest of the activity log file content

entry_count.description: Total number of entries in the activity log

delivery_head_count.description: Number of entries at the delivery HEAD commit

earlier_count.description: Number of entries at commits before the delivery HEAD

entries.description: Ordered list of classified activity entries

id.description: Entry ID: 0-based physical line number in the activity log (as string, not zero-padded)

command.description: First 100 characters of the executed command

oneOf.description: String 'unknown' when exit code is not available

head_anchor.description: True if this entry's head_sha equals the delivery HEAD commit SHA

log_pointer.description: Reference to locate the entry in the raw log (same as id)
